en.projects.title: MyStar — Taking Staroptic from physical retail to e-commerce
en.projects.intro: I built MyStar from the ground up as Staroptic’s dedicated Shopify storefront, creating a structured bilingual sales channel for eyewear and prescription ordering.

en.projects.ownership: Sole Developer · Built from the Ground Up
en.projects.context.title: Business Context
en.projects.context.copy: Staroptic is an established optical retailer that launched MyStar as its dedicated online brand and sales channel.
en.projects.challenge.title: Challenge
en.projects.challenge.copy: The storefront needed to organize a complex eyewear catalogue and translate key parts of the in-store optical sales process into a clear online journey.
en.projects.role.title: My Role
en.projects.role.copy: I led the storefront architecture, Shopify and frontend development, UX/UI decisions, localization, technical SEO, app integration, QA and ongoing improvements.

en.process.label: How We Work Together
en.process.title: A clear path from first conversation to launch.
en.process.intro: You always know what is being decided, what comes next and what I need from you. I keep the process focused and involve you at the points where your input matters.
en.process.step1.title: Discovery & Alignment
en.process.step1.desc: We begin with a focused conversation about your business, audience, requirements and what the project needs to accomplish. I identify priorities, dependencies and important constraints early so we start from a shared understanding.
en.process.step2.title: Scope & Technical Direction
en.process.step2.desc: Together, we confirm deliverables, responsibilities, milestones and project boundaries. I define the technical direction and clarify the content, assets and access needed before development begins.
en.process.step3.title: Design, Development & Reviews
en.process.step3.desc: I turn the agreed direction into working interfaces and functionality, making UX/UI and implementation decisions in context. You review progress at planned checkpoints—often through a preview or staging environment—so feedback stays timely and revisions remain focused.
en.process.step4.title: QA, Launch & Handoff
en.process.step4.desc: Before launch, I test responsive behavior, functionality and the final technical setup across relevant devices and scenarios. I then handle or support deployment and provide the agreed handoff, documentation or training needed to manage the finished product.
en.process.support: Optional ongoing support and improvements are available after launch.

sr.process.label: Kako izgleda saradnja
sr.process.title: Jasan put od prvog razgovora do lansiranja.
sr.process.intro: U svakom trenutku znate koje odluke donosimo, šta sledi i šta mi je potrebno sa vaše strane. Proces držim fokusiranim i uključujem vas onda kada je vaš doprinos važan.
sr.process.step1.title: Razumevanje cilja i usaglašavanje
sr.process.step1.desc: Počinjemo fokusiranim razgovorom o poslovanju, publici, zahtevima i cilju koji projekat treba da ispuni. Prioritete, važne zavisnosti i ograničenja prepoznajem na početku kako bismo imali zajedničko razumevanje.
sr.process.step2.title: Obim i tehnički pravac
sr.process.step2.desc: Zajedno potvrđujemo šta tačno isporučujem, ko je za šta odgovoran, ključne rokove i granice projekta. Definišem tehnički pravac i unapred preciziramo potreban sadržaj, materijale i pristupe sistemima.
sr.process.step3.title: Dizajn, razvoj i zajednički pregledi
sr.process.step3.desc: Dogovoreni pravac pretvaram u funkcionalno digitalno rešenje, donoseći UX/UI i razvojne odluke u kontekstu projekta. Napredak pregledamo u dogovorenim tačkama, po potrebi kroz testno okruženje, kako bi povratne informacije stigle na vreme, a dorade ostale fokusirane.
sr.process.step4.title: Provera kvaliteta, lansiranje i predaja
sr.process.step4.desc: Pre lansiranja proveravam responzivno ponašanje, funkcionalnosti i završnu tehničku postavku na relevantnim uređajima i kroz realne scenarije korišćenja. Zatim preuzimam lansiranje ili pružam podršku tokom objavljivanja i predajem dogovorenu dokumentaciju, smernice ili kratku obuku kada je potrebna.
sr.process.support: Po potrebi, saradnja može da se nastavi kroz dalju podršku i unapređenja nakon lansiranja.
